what: Lands with blaze-diagnostics' model.rs change in the same commit, or blaze-lints stops compiling. diag::Expansion gained `opaque: bool` (rustc's ExpnData::diagnostic_opaque: a builtin macro's expansion; no 'this error originates in' note names it, as the pinned rustc's emitter does). blaze-lints/src/check.rs:1418 must set it like blaze-diagnostics' Cx::expansion_of does. Replace `Some(Expansion { call_site: diag::in_query(call_site), kind, name, def_site })` with `let opaque = !matches!(call.loc(db).def.kind, MacroDefKind::Declarative(..) | MacroDefKind::ProcMacro(..)); Some(Expansion { call_site: diag::in_query(call_site), kind, name, def_site, opaque })`. rust-analyzer shows that line as the only E0063.

history.note: applied by tests-diag at the coordinator's ask (round 9 check); rust-analyzer 0 errors
